name: Normal shift
description: 8 h of normal work at about 5 °C. No fault.

name: Pump wear
description: Normal start; simulated pump wear begins at 3 h and becomes severe by 7.5 h.

name: After repair
description: 2 h of normal work after a simulated pump replacement.

name: Hot day, heavy load
description: 8 h of hard work at about 28 °C. No fault: should not raise alarms.
